subject: MAP: BrightCart evaluation packet, delivery milestones & usage ledger
messages:
From: Elena Novak <elena@brightcart.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@brightcart.com
Date: Thu, 06 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation assets + timeline request

Hi Rachel —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement and the ML team want to run a limited evaluation with Redwood before we move to a pilot. Can you send a simple MAP (deliverables + acceptance gates + timeline) and the smallest safe slice of prompt/testcase material we can run in our dev environment?

Key constraints from our side:
- Data must be ephemeral (30 day access, then revoke).
- No copying of real customer PII — the pack you share should be sanitized or synthetic.
- We need a sample of 1,200 test cases covering search, ranking, and NLU intents.

We expect procurement to confirm budget in two weeks, so an evaluation window of 2–3 weeks would be ideal. Can you propose a MAP and the packaging format so legal/procurement can review quickly?

If helpful, I can loop in our SRE for access details.

Thanks,
Elena Novak
Head of ML Ops, BrightCart
Elena@brightcart.com

[attachment: brightcart_request_spec.pdf (stub: 48KB)]
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Novak <elena@brightcart.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 06 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation assets + timeline request

Elena —

Appreciate the clear ask. Attached is a first-pass MAP and a minimal promptpack/fixture set for an ephemeral trial. Summary (high level):

- Deliverables:
  1) Prompt pack (sanitized + synthetic variants) — brightcart_promptpack_v1.zip (contains README + 1,200 small testcases)
  2) Eval testcases CSV (subset): eval_testcases_subset.csv (300 prioritized examples for quick smoke runs)
  3) MAP_BrightCart_v1.docx — proposed milestones, acceptance gates, rollback plan, and access revocation steps.

- Timeline proposal (example):
  * Day 0: Redwood shares artifacts and ephemeral credentials
  * Day 1–3: BrightCart smoke + integration checks
  * Day 4–14: Evaluation window (functional + perf sampling)
  * Day 15: Acceptance review / decision / next steps (pilot / scale / close)

- Usage constraints:
  * Artifacts are licensed for evaluation-only; no retention beyond 30 days from issuance.
  * No redistribution; internal read-only use permitted for evaluation stakeholders listed in MAP.
  * Outputs that recombine testcases into derivative datasets are prohibited.

Security note: we will provide a short checklist for your SRE to connect to our ephemeral endpoint (VPC peering or short-lived API key + IP allowlist).

I looped in Karthik (security) and Marissa (product) to confirm the access plan and final artifact contents. Please let us know any legal touches you need on the MAP.

Cheers,
Rachel Kim
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.ai

[attachments: MAP_BrightCart_v1.docx, brightcart_promptpack_v1.zip, eval_testcases_subset.csv]
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Elena Novak <elena@brightcart.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 06 May 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation assets + timeline request

Elena / Rachel —

Quick security/ops checklist for the MAP:
- Credentialing: we will issue a time-limited API key scoped to the evaluation project; key TTL = 30 days.
- Network: support both short-lived API keys and optional VPC peering. If you prefer peering, we need an initial CIDR and contact for SRE.
- Audit: token-level usage logs will be available for the evaluation period and retained per the MAP (we can export a CSV).
- Data handling: promptpack will be synthetically augmented; we will sign an attestation that no PII from Redwood customers is included.

If you share the SRE contact, we can schedule a short 30-min integration call tomorrow.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Platform Security, Redwood Inference

Cc: procue@brightcart.com, BrightCart Ops <ops@brightcart.com>
Date: Fri, 07 May 2026 08:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation assets + timeline request

Thanks, Rachel and Karthik — this looks good. A few procurement/legal asks before we can sign off on distribution of artifacts to our SRE/dev teams: 

1) Can Redwood confirm the exact revocation mechanism (API key revoke + confirmation email + capability to rotate any issued tokens)?
2) We need the MAP to include explicit acceptance criteria for the NLU intents (F1 thresholds) and a perf/latency target for tail p95 so our platform team can evaluate cost/throughput.
3) Please add a clause that derivative datasets created by BrightCart during evaluation will be used only for assessment and will be deleted at the end of the 30-day window; we will supply a deletion log back to Redwood.

I'll ask my legal team to do a short redline if anything else is required. Once the MAP is signed, procurement will request the sandbox access and the artifacts.

—Elena

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation assets + timeline request — acceptance gates and sample metrics

Elena —

Thanks for the feedback. I updated the MAP (see attached) to include:
- Acceptance criteria: pass rates and sample F1 thresholds for the NLU intents (we propose baseline F1 >= 0.78 for intent detection in the provided subset; can tune if you have target values).
- Latency target: p95 <= 420ms for the evaluation profile we included; we'll provide a small perf harness to reproduce the measurement.
- Revocation and audit: API key revoke is immediate and we will send a confirmation to the MAP contacts; token rotation is supported and documented.
- Derivative datasets: we accept a mutual deletion log exchange (BrightCart provides deletion CSV; Redwood acknowledges completion).

I've attached MAP_BrightCart_v1.docx (redlined) and a short acceptance-test runner README in the promptpack README. If that addresses legal/procurement asks we can finalize and issue credentials on Tuesday morning.

Naomi Feldman
Product Manager, Evaluation Programs, Redwood Inference

Naomi / Rachel —

Thank you — MAP looks acceptable, and legal has one minor redline around the deletion attestation format (we attached a short clause to the doc). Procurement will push the PO this afternoon subject to the attestation language. Once PO is in place please proceed with issuing the time-limited API keys and the artifact transfer link.

Proposed start: 2026-05-13 (Day 0) — 14 day evaluation window. Please confirm issuance timeline.

Best,
Elena
